layout_sources: https://statementsheet.com/how-to-convert-lcl-bank-statement-to-excel-csv/ and https://www.lido.app/fr/releve-bancaire-excel (LCL espace client, "Mes opérations", "Exporter": CSV or OFX, semicolon-separated, comma decimal)
notes: LCL "Mes opérations" export to CSV. No source found that shows the file itself; this is the most commonly remembered form and should be checked against a real download: no header row, semicolon-separated, one line per operation: date dd/mm/yyyy, signed amount with a comma decimal and no thousands mark, the means of payment (Carte, Virement, Prélèvement, Chèque), the cheque number, the label, an empty trailing field; newest first; a last line with no date carrying the account balance. Windows-1252 and CRLF assumed. The cheque line has no label, only its number. Closing = the balance on that last line. No currency is written.
